records.literal_gloss: For the director, with stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.

en.L: For the director: with stringed instruments. A psalm; a song.
en.B: For the music director. With stringed instruments. A psalm. A song.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To be played on stringed instruments. A song.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : avec instruments à cordes. Un psaume ; un cantique.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Avec instruments à cordes. Un psaume. Un cantique.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. À jouer sur des instruments à cordes. Un chant.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa ala za nyuzi. Zaburi; wimbo.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa ala za nyuzi. Zaburi. Wimbo.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ipigwe kwa ala za nyuzi. Wimbo.

es.L: Al director del coro: con instrumentos de cuerda. Un salmo; un cántico.
es.B: Al director del coro. Con instrumentos de cuerda. Un salmo. Un cántico.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Para tocarse con instrumentos de cuerda. Un canto.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: với đàn dây. [Một] thi thiên; [một] bài ca.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Với đàn dây. Thi thiên. Bài ca.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Để chơi bằng đàn dây. Bài ca.

ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 현악기에 맞추어. 시. 노래.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해. 현악기로 연주하는 노래.

pt.L: Para o regente: com instrumentos de cordas. Salmo; cântico.
pt.B: Para o mestre de música. Com instrumentos de cordas. Salmo. Cântico.
pt.R: Para quem dirige a música. Para ser tocado com instrumentos de cordas. Uma canção.

am.L: ለመዘምራን አለቃ፤ በባለ አውታር መሣሪያዎች። መዝሙር፤ ቅኔ።
am.B: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። በባለ አውታር መሣሪያዎች። መዝሙር። ቅኔ።
am.R: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። በባለ አውታር መሣሪያዎች የሚዘመር። መዝሙር።

hi.L: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए: तारवाले बाजों के साथ। भजन; गीत।
hi.B: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। तारवाले बाजों के साथ। भजन। गीत।
hi.R: गायक-मंडली के अगुवे के लिए। तारवाले बाजों पर बजाने के लिए। गीत।

ru.L: Руководителю хора: на струнных инструментах. Псалом; песнь.
ru.B: Руководителю хора. На струнных инструментах. Псалом. Песнь.
ru.R: Для руководителя музыкантов. Исполнять на струнных инструментах. Песня.

ja.L: 指揮する者のために。弦楽器に合わせて。賛歌、歌。
ja.B: 音楽を導く者のために。弦楽器に合わせて。賛歌。歌。
ja.R: 音楽を導く人のために。弦楽器で演奏する。歌。

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: stringed instruments: to be accompanied by strings
decisions.reason: As in 4:1 and 54:1, the word (neginot) means music played on stringed instruments.

decisions.choice: A song
decisions.reason: Readable gives one plain word for the two words for a song.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 67.
alternatives: spans like the English ones (from verse 2)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: binginot "弦楽器に合わせて" (L, B), "弦楽器で演奏する" (R); mizmor shir "賛歌、歌" (L), "賛歌。歌。" (B), "歌" (R)
decisions.reason: Music term and title words as the Psalter conventions (PSA-1, 4:1).

source.text: אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְחָנֵּ֥נוּ וִֽיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ יָ֤אֵ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו אִתָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: God, may he be gracious to us and bless us; may he make shine his face with us. Selah.

en.L: God, may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} be gracious to us and bless us; \q may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face shine among us. Selah
en.B: May God show us grace and bless us; \q may {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} let the light of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face shine on us. Selah
en.R: May God be kind to us and bless us. \q May {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} look on us with a smile of favor. Selah

fr.L: Dieu, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous fasse grâce et nous bénisse ; \q qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse briller {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face parmi nous. Sélah
fr.B: Que Dieu nous fasse grâce et nous bénisse ; \q qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fasse resplendir sur nous la lumière de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face. Sélah
fr.R: Que Dieu soit bon pour nous et nous bénisse. \q Qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous regarde avec un sourire de faveur. Sélah

sw.L: Mungu, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} na atufanyie neema na atubariki; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} na aufanye uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} ung'ae kati yetu. Sela
sw.B: Mungu na atuonyeshe neema na kutubariki; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} na aiangazishe nuru ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} juu yetu. Sela
sw.R: Mungu na atuhurumie na kutubariki. \q Na atutazame kwa tabasamu la upendeleo. Sela

es.L: Oh Dios, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} tenga gracia de nosotros y nos bendiga; \q que haga resplandecer {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro entre nosotros. Selah
es.B: Que Dios nos muestre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gracia y nos bendiga; \q que haga brillar sobre nosotros la luz de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro. Selah
es.R: Que Dios sea bueno con nosotros y nos bendiga. \q Que nos mire con una sonrisa de favor. Selah

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm ơn cho chúng ta và ban phước cho chúng ta; \q nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chiếu sáng giữa chúng ta. Sê-la
vi.B: Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời ban ơn cho chúng ta và ban phước cho chúng ta; \q nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho ánh sáng của mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} soi trên chúng ta. Sê-la
vi.R: Nguyện Đức Chúa Trời tử tế với chúng ta và ban phước cho chúng ta. \q Nguyện {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mỉm cười nhìn chúng ta với lòng ưu ái. Sê-la

ko.L: 하나님께서 우리에게 은혜를 베푸시고 우리에게 복을 주시기를. \q 그분의 얼굴을 우리 가운데 비추시기를. 셀라.
ko.B: 하나님께서 우리에게 은혜를 베푸시고 복을 주시기를. \q 그분의 얼굴빛을 우리에게 비추시기를. 셀라.
ko.R: 하나님께서 우리에게 친절을 베푸시고 복을 주시기를. \q 그분께서 우리를 기쁘게 바라보시기를. 셀라.

pt.L: Deus, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seja gracioso conosco e nos abençoe; \q que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faça a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} face brilhar entre nós. Selá
pt.B: Que Deus nos mostre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça e nos abençoe; \q que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faça brilhar sobre nós a luz da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} face. Selá
pt.R: Que Deus seja bondoso conosco e nos abençoe. \q Que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} olhe para nós com um sorriso de favor. Selá

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ይራራልን፤ ይባርከንም፤ \q ፊቱን በእኛ ላይ ያብራ። ሴላ
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሞገሱን ያድለን፤ ይባርከንም፤ \q ፊቱ በእኛ ላይ ያብራ። ሴላ
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ቸርነቱን ያሳየን፤ መልካምም ያድርግልን። \q በደስታ ይመልከተን። ሴላ

hi.L: परमेश्वर हम पर अनुग्रह करें और हमें आशीष दें; \q वे अपना मुख हमारे बीच चमकाएँ। सेला
hi.B: परमेश्वर हम पर अनुग्रह करें और हमें आशीष दें; \q वे अपने मुख का तेज हम पर डालें। सेला
hi.R: परमेश्वर हम पर दया करें और हमें आशीष दें। \q वे प्रसन्न होकर हमारी ओर देखें। सेला

ru.L: Боже, да помилует {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} нас и благословит нас; \q да осияет {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} лицом своим среди нас. Села
ru.B: Пусть Бог явит нам милость и благословит нас; \q пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} даст свету своего лица сиять над нами. Села
ru.R: Пусть Бог будет добр к нам и благословит нас. \q Пусть {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} смотрит на нас с радостью и благоволением. Села

ja.L: 神が、わたしたちをあわれみ、わたしたちを祝福してくださるように。 \q その顔を、わたしたちと共に輝かせてくださるように。セラ
ja.B: 神が、わたしたちに恵みを示し、祝福してくださるように。 \q その顔の光を、わたしたちの上に輝かせてくださるように。セラ
ja.R: 神が、わたしたちをあわれみ、祝福してくださるように。 \q ほほえみながら、わたしたちを見てくださるように。セラ

decisions.choice: the priestly blessing
decisions.reason: The words echo the blessing the priests spoke over Israel: "The LORD bless you and keep you; the LORD make his face shine on you and be gracious to you" (Numbers 6:24-26). Here the people ask it for themselves, so that the nations may come to know God (verse 3).

decisions.choice: God in place of the name
decisions.reason: The priestly blessing uses the name, the LORD; this psalm says "God". Psalms 42-83 mostly call God "God" ('elohim) where other psalms use the name (compare Psalm 53 with Psalm 14). The word in the text is rendered.

decisions.choice: make his face shine: look on with favor
decisions.reason: A shining face is a kind and favorable look, as of a king pleased with a subject (4:7; 31:17; Proverbs 16:15).

decisions.choice: look on us with a smile of favor
alternatives: make his face shine on us
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m3).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" for "us" while God is spoken of (2, 7-8), "Ngài" for "you" when he is addressed (3-6)
decisions.reason: The psalm moves between a blessing spoken about God among the people and praise spoken to him; Vietnamese marks this with "chúng ta", which includes the hearers, as in the priestly blessing it echoes (see the meaning decision).

decisions.choice: The wishes about God (verses 2, 7-8) are in the plain written style with "우리"; the prayer to God (verses 3-6) is in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a: about God in the plain style, to God in 합쇼체. Verse 2 speaks of God in the third person (the English "may he"), so its "us" is "우리"; the Literal opening "God, may he" is given as a wish with God as subject, since Korean cannot address God and speak of him as "he" in one breath.

decisions.choice: "셀라" kept at the end of the verse
decisions.reason: A word whose meaning is no longer known, probably a musical direction (meaning decision m4); see Psalm 46:4.

decisions.choice: nos abençoe; faça a sua face brilhar (L, B); seja bondoso (R)
decisions.reason: The verse echoes the priestly blessing (m1), so it keeps the words of the Portuguese of Numbers 6:24-25 where the Hebrew is the same: "abençoe", "faça a sua face brilhar", and "seja bondoso" at Readable. The psalm is drafted from the Hebrew; the familiar wording of other versions is avoided.

decisions.choice: the words of the priestly blessing kept from Numbers 6:24-25 on main, level by level: "ይባርክ", "ፊቱን ... ያብራ", "ይራራል" (L); "ሞገሱን ያድል", "ፊቱ ... ያብራ" (B); "መልካም ያድርግ", "ቸርነቱን ያሳይ", "በደስታ ይመልከት" (R), turned to "us"
decisions.reason: The verse echoes the blessing of Numbers 6 (m1), with God (Elohim) in place of the divine name (m2) and "us" in place of "you"; where the Hebrew words agree, the Amharic keeps the Numbers wording so the echo is heard.

decisions.choice: "अनुग्रह करें", "आशीष दें", "अपना मुख ... चमकाएँ" (L), "अपने मुख का तेज ... डालें" (B), "प्रसन्न होकर ... देखें" (R)
decisions.reason: The line echoes the priestly blessing (meaning m1), so each level uses the Hindi words of Numbers 6:24-25 at that level in this translation, turned to "us". The psalm says "God", not the divine name (meaning m2), so there is no divine_name span.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span; honorific "वे" of God, "तू" to God
alternatives: a capitalised pronoun, as the English "He", "You"
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi and the Hindi has no deity_pronoun spans (style guide, section 7). This holds for the whole psalm.

decisions.choice: "осияет лицом" (L); "свету своего лица сиять" (B); "смотрит на нас с радостью" (R)
decisions.reason: The line echoes the priestly blessing of Numbers 6:24-25; each level stays close to the Numbers wording in this translation (Readable keeps its "смотрит ... с радостью"), but says "God" and "us" as the psalm does.

decisions.choice: yechonnenu "あわれみ" (L, R), "恵みを示し" (B); ya'er panaw "その顔を…輝かせて" (L, B), "ほほえみながら…見て" (R)
decisions.reason: The priestly blessing (Numbers 6:24-26) echoed (m1), with 神 where Numbers has the divine name (m2); Japanese keeps the words of the Numbers blessing (祝福し, 顔を輝かせ) and the Psalter's chanan forms. The shining face is looking on with favor (m3).

records.literal_gloss: To know on the earth your way, among all nations your salvation.

en.L: That [they may] know on the earth {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} way, \q among all nations {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation.
en.B: Then the earth will know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} ways, \q and every nation {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} power to save.
en.R: Then everyone on earth will learn what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are like. \q All nations will see how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save.

fr.L: Afin [qu’on] connaisse sur la terre {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} chemin, \q parmi toutes les nations {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut.
fr.B: Alors la terre connaîtra {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} chemins, \q et chaque nation {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} puissance qui sauve.
fr.R: Alors tout le monde sur la terre apprendra comment {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es. \q Toutes les nations verront comment {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sauves.

sw.L: Ili [watu] waijue njia {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} duniani, \q wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kati ya mataifa yote.
sw.B: Ndipo dunia itakapozijua njia {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, \q na kila taifa uwezo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} wa kuokoa.
sw.R: Ndipo kila mtu duniani atajifunza jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo. \q Mataifa yote yataona jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unavyookoa.

es.L: Para que [se] conozca en la tierra {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} camino, \q entre todas las naciones {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación.
es.B: Entonces la tierra conocerá {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} caminos, \q y todas las naciones {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} poder para salvar.
es.R: Entonces todos en la tierra aprenderán cómo eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. \q Todas las naciones verán cómo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} salvas.

vi.L: Để [người ta] biết đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên đất, \q [và biết] sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giữa mọi dân tộc.
vi.B: Khi ấy cả đất sẽ biết các đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và mọi dân tộc sẽ biết quyền năng giải cứu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Khi ấy mọi người trên đất sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng thế nào. \q Mọi dân tộc sẽ thấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu ra sao.

ko.L: 땅에서 주님의 길을, \q 모든 민족들 가운데서 주님의 구원을 알게 하시려는 것입니다.
ko.B: 그러면 온 땅이 주님의 길을 알고, \q 모든 민족이 주님의 구원하시는 능력을 알 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러면 땅 위의 모든 사람이 주님이 어떤 분이신지 알게 될 것입니다. \q 모든 민족이 주님께서 어떻게 구원하시는지 보게 될 것입니다.

pt.L: Para que [se] conheça na terra o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} caminho, \q entre todas as nações a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} salvação.
pt.B: Então a terra conhecerá os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} caminhos, \q e todas as nações, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} poder de salvar.
pt.R: Então todos na terra vão aprender como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és. \q Todas as nações vão ver como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvas.

am.L: መንገድህ በምድር ላይ [ይታወቅ] ዘንድ፣ \q ማዳንህም በሕዝቦች ሁሉ መካከል።
am.B: ያን ጊዜ ምድር መንገድህን ታውቃለች፤ \q ሕዝብ ሁሉ የማዳን ኃይልህን ያውቃል።
am.R: ያን ጊዜ በምድር ያሉ ሁሉ አንተ ምን ዓይነት እንደ ሆንህ ይማራሉ። \q ሕዝቦች ሁሉ እንዴት እንደምታድን ያያሉ።

hi.L: कि पृथ्वी पर [लोग] तेरा मार्ग जानें, \q सब जातियों में तेरा उद्धार।
hi.B: तब पृथ्वी तेरे मार्गों को जानेगी, \q और हर देश तेरी उद्धार करने की सामर्थ्य को।
hi.R: तब पृथ्वी पर सब लोग जान लेंगे कि तू कैसा है। \q सब देश देखेंगे कि तू कैसे बचाता है।

ru.L: Чтобы [узнали] на земле путь {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}}, \q среди всех народов — спасение {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}}.
ru.B: Тогда земля узнает {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} пути, \q и все народы — {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} спасающую силу.
ru.R: Тогда все на земле узнают, какой {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}. \q Все народы увидят, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} спасаешь.

ja.L: 地の上で、あなたの道が知られるために、 \q すべての国の民の間で、あなたの救いが[知られるために]。
ja.B: そうすれば、地はあなたの道を知り、 \q すべての国の民は、あなたの救いの力を知る。
ja.R: そうすれば、地上のすべての人が、あなたがどのような方かを知る。 \q すべての国々が、あなたの救いを見る。

decisions.choice: to know: the purpose of the blessing
decisions.reason: The verb is an infinitive, "to know", that depends on verse 2: God's blessing on Israel is meant to make him known to all nations (Genesis 12:2-3). The Selah between them does not break the thought.

decisions.choice: your way: how God acts and what he requires
decisions.reason: God's way is both his way of dealing with people and the way he teaches them to live (25:4; 103:7).

decisions.choice: salvation: rescue, saving help
decisions.reason: The word (yeshu'ah) is God's rescue of his people from danger.

decisions.choice: then
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable begin a new sentence after the Selah and state the purpose as a result.

decisions.choice: lada'at "…知られるために" (L), "そうすれば…知り" (B, R); darkekha "あなたの道" (L, B), "あなたがどのような方か" (R)
decisions.reason: The infinitive gives the purpose of the blessing (m1); God's way is how he acts and what he requires (m2).

records.literal_gloss: Peoples will praise you, God; peoples will praise you, all of them.

en.L: Peoples will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, God; \q peoples will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, all of them.
en.B: May the peoples give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks, God; \q may every people give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks!
en.R: God, may people of every nation praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! \q May all of them praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!

fr.L: Les peuples {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loueront, Dieu ; \q les peuples {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loueront, eux tous.
fr.B: Que les peuples {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendent grâce, Dieu ; \q que tous les peuples {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendent grâce !
fr.R: Dieu, que les gens de toutes les nations {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louent ! \q Qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louent tous !

sw.L: Mataifa yatakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee Mungu; \q mataifa yatakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, yote.
sw.B: Mataifa na yakushukuru {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee Mungu; \q kila taifa na likushukuru {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}!
sw.R: Ee Mungu, watu wa kila taifa na wakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}! \q Wote na wakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}!

es.L: Los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabarán, oh Dios; \q los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabarán, todos ellos.
es.B: Que los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} den gracias, oh Dios; \q ¡que todos los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} den gracias!
es.R: ¡Dios, que la gente de todas las naciones {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabe! \q ¡Que todos ellos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alaben!

vi.L: Các dân sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời; \q các dân sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tất cả họ.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện các dân cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q nguyện mọi dân tộc đều cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện người của mọi dân tộc ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Nguyện tất cả họ đều ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 민족들이 주님을 찬양할 것입니다, 하나님. \q 모든 민족들이 주님을 찬양할 것입니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 민족들이 주님께 감사하게 해 주십시오. \q 모든 민족이 주님께 감사하게 해 주십시오!
ko.R: 하나님, 모든 나라 사람들이 주님을 찬양하게 해 주십시오! \q 그들 모두가 주님을 찬양하게 해 주십시오!

pt.L: Os povos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvarão, Deus; \q os povos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvarão, todos eles.
pt.B: Que os povos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deem graças, Deus; \q que todos os povos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deem graças!
pt.R: Deus, que as pessoas de todas as nações {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvem! \q Que todas elas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvem!

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ወገኖች ያመሰግኑሃል፤ \q ወገኖች ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ሕዝቦች ያመስግኑህ፤ \q ሕዝብ ሁሉ ያመስግንህ!
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ የየአገሩ ሰዎች ያመስግኑህ! \q ሁሉም ያመስግኑህ!

hi.L: हे परमेश्वर, देश-देश के लोग तेरी स्तुति करेंगे; \q देश-देश के लोग, वे सब के सब, तेरी स्तुति करेंगे।
hi.B: हे परमेश्वर, देश-देश के लोग तेरा धन्यवाद करें; \q हर देश के लोग तेरा धन्यवाद करें!
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, हर देश के लोग तेरी स्तुति करें! \q वे सब के सब तेरी स्तुति करें!

ru.L: Будут славить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} племена, Боже; \q будут славить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} племена, все они.
ru.B: Пусть племена благодарят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, Боже; \q пусть все племена благодарят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}!
ru.R: Боже, пусть люди всех народов хвалят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}! \q Пусть все они хвалят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}!

ja.L: もろもろの民は、あなたに感謝する、神よ。 \q もろもろの民は、みな、あなたに感謝する。
ja.B: 神よ、もろもろの民が、あなたに感謝するように。 \q すべての民が、あなたに感謝するように！
ja.R: 神よ、すべての国の人々が、あなたをたたえるように！ \q 人々がみな、あなたをたたえるように！

decisions.choice: will praise: a wish
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as a wish ("may they praise") or a statement of what will happen. As in verse 2, the psalm is a prayer, so Balanced and Readable say "may".

decisions.choice: praise: give thanks, acknowledge
decisions.reason: The verb (yadah) is to praise by declaring what someone has done; it includes thanks and confession.

decisions.choice: a refrain
decisions.reason: This verse is repeated as verse 6. The two refrains frame the center of the psalm, verse 5.

decisions.choice: the peoples (ʿammim) as "ወገኖች" and the nations (goyim, leʾummim, verses 3 and 5) as "ሕዝቦች" (L); "ሕዝቦች" for both at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The psalm sets the words side by side (verse 5); Literal keeps them apart as the terms list does where both stand together, and the refrain (verses 4 and 6) keeps one wording.

decisions.choice: a wish ("करें") at Balanced and Readable; a statement ("करेंगे") at Literal
decisions.reason: The verbs can be a wish or a statement (meaning m1); as the English does, Literal keeps the future and Balanced and Readable pray it. Verse 6 repeats the refrain in the same words.

decisions.choice: "племена" for ammim, "народы" for the nations
decisions.reason: The note pairs "народы" (the nations) with "племена" (the peoples, ammim); Literal and Balanced keep the pair through the refrain of verses 4 and 6 and through verse 5, so the alternation of the Hebrew words stays visible. Readable says "народы" throughout.

decisions.choice: yodukha "あなたに感謝する" (L), "感謝するように" (B), "たたえるように" (R); the refrain is repeated word for word in 67:6
decisions.reason: hodah 感謝する (Psalter conventions), Readable "たたえる" as the English R "praise"; the imperfect is read as a wish (m1, uncertain) at B and R, as the English.

source.text: יִֽשְׂמְח֥וּ וִֽירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי־תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישׁ֑וֹר וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים׀בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Nations will rejoice and sing for joy, for you judge peoples [with] uprightness, and nations on the earth you guide them. Selah.

en.L: Nations will rejoice and sing for joy, \q for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} judge peoples [with] uprightness, \q and nations on the earth, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} guide them. Selah
en.B: Let the nations celebrate and shout with joy, \q because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} judge the peoples fairly \q and lead the nations across the earth. Selah
en.R: May the nations be happy and sing! \q You judge people in a way that is fair, \q and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} lead the nations of the world. Selah

fr.L: Les nations se réjouiront et crieront de joie, \q car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} juges les peuples [avec] droiture, \q et les nations sur la terre, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les conduis. Sélah
fr.B: Que les nations soient en fête et crient de joie, \q parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} juges les peuples avec équité \q et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} conduis les nations sur la terre. Sélah
fr.R: Que les nations soient heureuses et chantent ! \q Tu juges les gens avec justice, \q et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} conduis les nations du monde. Sélah

sw.L: Mataifa yatafurahi na kuimba kwa shangwe, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unawahukumu watu [kwa] unyofu, \q na mataifa duniani, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayaongoza. Sela
sw.B: Mataifa na yasherehekee na kupiga kelele za furaha, \q kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unawahukumu watu kwa haki \q na kuyaongoza mataifa katika dunia yote. Sela
sw.R: Mataifa na yafurahi na kuimba! \q Unawahukumu watu kwa njia iliyo ya haki, \q na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayaongoza mataifa ya ulimwengu. Sela

es.L: Las naciones se alegrarán y cantarán con júbilo, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} juzgas a los pueblos [con] rectitud, \q y a las naciones en la tierra, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} las guías. Selah
es.B: Que las naciones hagan fiesta y griten de alegría, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} juzgas a los pueblos con justicia \q y guías a las naciones por toda la tierra. Selah
es.R: ¡Que las naciones estén felices y canten! \q Tú juzgas a la gente de manera justa, \q y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} guías a las naciones del mundo. Selah

vi.L: Các nước sẽ vui mừng và reo hát, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử các dân [bằng] sự ngay thẳng, \q và các nước trên đất, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn dắt họ. Sê-la
vi.B: Nguyện các nước ăn mừng và reo hò vui vẻ, \q vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xét xử các dân công minh \q và dẫn dắt các nước trên khắp đất. Sê-la
vi.R: Nguyện các dân tộc vui mừng và ca hát! \q Ngài xét xử người ta cách công bằng, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dẫn dắt các dân tộc trên thế giới. Sê-la

ko.L: 나라들이 기뻐하며 기뻐 노래할 것입니다. \q 주님께서 민족들을 공정하게 재판하시고, \q 땅 위의 나라들을 인도하시기 때문입니다. 셀라.
ko.B: 나라들이 즐거워하며 기뻐 외치게 해 주십시오. \q 주님께서 민족들을 공평하게 재판하시고 \q 온 땅의 나라들을 이끄십니다. 셀라.
ko.R: 나라들이 기뻐하며 노래하게 해 주십시오! \q 주님께서는 사람들을 공정하게 재판하시고, \q 세상의 나라들을 이끄십니다. 셀라.

pt.L: As nações se alegrarão e cantarão de alegria, \q pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} julgas os povos [com] retidão, \q e as nações na terra, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as guias. Selá
pt.B: Que as nações festejem e gritem de alegria, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} julgas os povos com justiça \q e conduzes as nações por toda a terra. Selá
pt.R: Que as nações fiquem felizes e cantem! \q Tu julgas as pessoas de maneira justa, \q e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} guias as nações do mundo. Selá

am.L: ሕዝቦች ደስ ይላቸዋል፤ እልልም ይላሉ፤ \q ወገኖችን በቅንነት ትፈርዳለህና፤ \q በምድር ያሉትንም ሕዝቦች ትመራቸዋለህ። ሴላ
am.B: ሕዝቦች ደስ ይበላቸው፤ በደስታም እልል ይበሉ፤ \q አንተ ለሕዝቦች በትክክል ትፈርዳለህና፤ \q በምድር ያሉትንም ሕዝቦች ትመራለህ። ሴላ
am.R: ሕዝቦች ደስ ይበላቸው፤ ይዘምሩም! \q ለሰዎች በትክክል ትፈርዳለህ፤ \q የዓለምንም ሕዝቦች ትመራለህ። ሴላ

hi.L: जातियाँ आनंदित होंगी और जयजयकार करेंगी, \q क्योंकि तू लोगों का न्याय सीधाई से करता है, \q और पृथ्वी की जातियाँ, तू उनकी अगुवाई करता है। सेला
hi.B: देश-देश उत्सव मनाएँ और आनंद से जयजयकार करें, \q क्योंकि तू लोगों का न्याय खराई से करता है \q और पृथ्वी भर के देशों की अगुवाई करता है। सेला
hi.R: सब देश आनंदित हों और गाएँ! \q तू लोगों का न्याय ठीक-ठीक करता है, \q और तू संसार के देशों की अगुवाई करता है। सेला

ru.L: Будут веселиться и ликовать народы, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} судишь племена [с] правотой \q и народы на земле — {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} ведёшь их. Села
ru.B: Пусть народы веселятся и радостно восклицают, \q потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} справедливо судишь племена \q и ведёшь народы по всей земле. Села
ru.R: Пусть народы радуются и поют! \q Ты судишь людей справедливо \q и ведёшь народы мира. Села

ja.L: 民らは喜び、喜び歌う。 \q あなたが、もろもろの民を公平に裁き、 \q 地の上の民らを導かれるからである。セラ
ja.B: 民らが喜び祝い、喜び叫ぶように。 \q あなたは、もろもろの民を公正に裁き、 \q 地上の民らを導かれるからだ。セラ
ja.R: 国々の人々が喜び、歌うように！ \q あなたは、人々を公平に裁かれる。 \q あなたは、世界の国々を導かれる。セラ

decisions.choice: judge: rule with justice
decisions.reason: To judge (shafat) is to govern and to set things right; the nations rejoice because God's rule is fair to them (96:10-13).

decisions.choice: uprightness: what is level and fair
decisions.reason: The word (mishor) is level ground, and so fairness.

decisions.choice: guide: lead like a shepherd
decisions.reason: The verb (nachah) is used of leading a flock or leading Israel in the wilderness (23:3; 77:21).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

decisions.choice: mishor "公平に" (L, R), "公正に" (B); tanchem "導かれる" every level
decisions.reason: Uprightness is what is level and fair (m2); the guiding is a shepherd's leading (m3). le'ummim 民ら (L, B), 'ammim もろもろの民 (L, B) as the Psalter conventions.

records.literal_gloss: Peoples will praise you, God; peoples will praise you, all of them.

en.L: Peoples will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, God; \q peoples will praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, all of them.
en.B: May the peoples give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks, God; \q may every people give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks!
en.R: God, may people of every nation praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! \q May all of them praise {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}!

fr.L: Les peuples {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loueront, Dieu ; \q les peuples {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} loueront, eux tous.
fr.B: Que les peuples {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendent grâce, Dieu ; \q que tous les peuples {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendent grâce !
fr.R: Dieu, que les gens de toutes les nations {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louent ! \q Qu’ils {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louent tous !

sw.L: Mataifa yatakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee Mungu; \q mataifa yatakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, yote.
sw.B: Mataifa na yakushukuru {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Ee Mungu; \q kila taifa na likushukuru {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}!
sw.R: Ee Mungu, watu wa kila taifa na wakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}! \q Wote na wakusifu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}!

es.L: Los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabarán, oh Dios; \q los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabarán, todos ellos.
es.B: Que los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} den gracias, oh Dios; \q ¡que todos los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} den gracias!
es.R: ¡Dios, que la gente de todas las naciones {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alabe! \q ¡Que todos ellos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} alaben!

vi.L: Các dân sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy Đức Chúa Trời; \q các dân sẽ ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tất cả họ.
vi.B: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện các dân cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q nguyện mọi dân tộc đều cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, nguyện người của mọi dân tộc ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Nguyện tất cả họ đều ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

ko.L: 민족들이 주님을 찬양할 것입니다, 하나님. \q 모든 민족들이 주님을 찬양할 것입니다.
ko.B: 하나님, 민족들이 주님께 감사하게 해 주십시오. \q 모든 민족이 주님께 감사하게 해 주십시오!
ko.R: 하나님, 모든 나라 사람들이 주님을 찬양하게 해 주십시오! \q 그들 모두가 주님을 찬양하게 해 주십시오!

pt.L: Os povos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvarão, Deus; \q os povos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvarão, todos eles.
pt.B: Que os povos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deem graças, Deus; \q que todos os povos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} deem graças!
pt.R: Deus, que as pessoas de todas as nações {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvem! \q Que todas elas {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvem!

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ወገኖች ያመሰግኑሃል፤ \q ወገኖች ሁሉ ያመሰግኑሃል።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ ሕዝቦች ያመስግኑህ፤ \q ሕዝብ ሁሉ ያመስግንህ!
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ሆይ፣ የየአገሩ ሰዎች ያመስግኑህ! \q ሁሉም ያመስግኑህ!

hi.L: हे परमेश्वर, देश-देश के लोग तेरी स्तुति करेंगे; \q देश-देश के लोग, वे सब के सब, तेरी स्तुति करेंगे।
hi.B: हे परमेश्वर, देश-देश के लोग तेरा धन्यवाद करें; \q हर देश के लोग तेरा धन्यवाद करें!
hi.R: हे परमेश्वर, हर देश के लोग तेरी स्तुति करें! \q वे सब के सब तेरी स्तुति करें!

ru.L: Будут славить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} племена, Боже; \q будут славить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} племена, все они.
ru.B: Пусть племена благодарят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, Боже; \q пусть все племена благодарят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}!
ru.R: Боже, пусть люди всех народов хвалят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}! \q Пусть все они хвалят {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}!

ja.L: もろもろの民は、あなたに感謝する、神よ。 \q もろもろの民は、みな、あなたに感謝する。
ja.B: 神よ、もろもろの民が、あなたに感謝するように。 \q すべての民が、あなたに感謝するように！
ja.R: 神よ、すべての国の人々が、あなたをたたえるように！ \q 人々がみな、あなたをたたえるように！

decisions.choice: the refrain again
decisions.reason: The refrain of verse 4 returns word for word.

decisions.choice: Word for word as 67:4
decisions.reason: The refrain again (m1).

source.text: אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] earth has given its produce; he will bless us, God, our God.

en.L: [The] earth has given its produce; \q God, our God, will bless us.
en.B: The earth has brought forth its crops; \q God, our own God, will bless us.
en.R: The ground has produced its crops. \q God, our God, will keep doing us good.

fr.L: [La] terre a donné son produit ; \q Dieu, notre Dieu, nous bénira.
fr.B: La terre a donné ses récoltes ; \q Dieu, notre Dieu, nous bénira.
fr.R: La terre a produit ses récoltes. \q Dieu, notre Dieu, continuera à nous faire du bien.

sw.L: Nchi imetoa mazao yake; \q Mungu, Mungu wetu, atatubariki.
sw.B: Dunia imezaa mavuno yake; \q Mungu, Mungu wetu mwenyewe, atatubariki.
sw.R: Ardhi imetoa mavuno yake. \q Mungu, Mungu wetu, ataendelea kututendea mema.

es.L: [La] tierra ha dado su fruto; \q Dios, nuestro Dios, nos bendecirá.
es.B: La tierra ha dado sus cosechas; \q Dios, nuestro propio Dios, nos bendecirá.
es.R: La tierra ha producido sus cosechas. \q Dios, nuestro Dios, seguirá haciéndonos bien.

vi.L: Đất đã sinh hoa lợi của nó; \q Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta, sẽ ban phước cho chúng ta.
vi.B: Đất đã sinh sản mùa màng; \q Đức Chúa Trời, chính Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta, sẽ ban phước cho chúng ta.
vi.R: Đất đã cho mùa màng. \q Đức Chúa Trời, Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta, sẽ tiếp tục làm điều tốt cho chúng ta.

ko.L: 땅이 그 소산을 내었으니, \q 하나님, 우리 하나님께서 우리에게 복을 주실 것이다.
ko.B: 땅이 곡식을 내었으니, \q 하나님, 우리의 하나님께서 우리에게 복을 주실 것이다.
ko.R: 땅이 곡식을 내었다. \q 하나님, 곧 우리 하나님께서 앞으로도 우리에게 좋은 것을 주실 것이다.

pt.L: [A] terra deu o seu fruto; \q Deus, o nosso Deus, nos abençoará.
pt.B: A terra produziu as suas colheitas; \q Deus, o nosso próprio Deus, nos abençoará.
pt.R: O solo deu as suas colheitas. \q Deus, o nosso Deus, vai continuar nos fazendo o bem.

am.L: ምድር ፍሬዋን ሰጠች፤ \q እግዚአብሔር አምላካችን ይባርከናል።
am.B: ምድር ሰብሏን አፍርታለች፤ \q እግዚአብሔር የራሳችን አምላክ ይባርከናል።
am.R: ምድሪቱ ሰብሏን ሰጥታለች። \q እግዚአብሔር አምላካችን መልካም ማድረጉን ይቀጥላል።

hi.L: भूमि ने अपनी उपज दी है; \q परमेश्वर, हमारे परमेश्वर, हमें आशीष देंगे।
hi.B: भूमि ने अपनी फ़सल दी है; \q परमेश्वर, हमारे अपने परमेश्वर, हमें आशीष देंगे।
hi.R: ज़मीन में फ़सल उगी है। \q परमेश्वर, हमारे परमेश्वर, हमारा भला करते रहेंगे।

ru.L: Земля дала плод свой; \q благословит нас Бог, Бог наш.
ru.B: Земля принесла свой урожай; \q Бог, наш Бог, благословит нас.
ru.R: Земля дала урожай. \q Бог, наш Бог, и дальше будет делать нам добро.

ja.L: 地は、その産物を出した。 \q 神、わたしたちの神は、わたしたちを祝福される。
ja.B: 地は、その実りをもたらした。 \q 神、わたしたちの神が、わたしたちを祝福してくださる。
ja.R: 大地は、作物を実らせた。 \q わたしたちの神は、これからも、わたしたちに良くしてくださる。

decisions.choice: has given ... will bless: a harvest as a sign
alternatives: the earth will give its produce
decisions.reason: The first verb is past: a harvest has come in, perhaps the occasion of the psalm, at a harvest festival. The second can be future or a wish. The harvest is taken as a sign of the blessing still to come.

decisions.choice: the earth gives its produce
decisions.reason: The words echo the promise of Leviticus 26:4: if Israel keeps the covenant, "the land will give its produce".

decisions.choice: keep doing us good
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's blessing brings here.

decisions.choice: "भूमि ने अपनी उपज दी है" (L), "... फ़सल दी है" (B), "ज़मीन में फ़सल उगी है" (R)
decisions.reason: The words echo the promise of Leviticus 26:4 (meaning m2), so each level uses that verse's Hindi wording at the same level, in the past tense.

decisions.choice: natenah … yevarekhenu "出した" (past) … "祝福される" (future) at every level
decisions.reason: The harvest is read as a sign of the blessing still to come (m1, uncertain), as the English.

records.literal_gloss: He will bless us, God, and they will fear him, all [the] ends of [the] earth.

en.L: God will bless us, \q and all the ends of the earth will fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: God is going to bless us, \q and all the far corners of the earth will hold {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in awe.
en.R: God will bless us. \q Then people everywhere, even in the farthest places, will honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with awe.

fr.L: Dieu nous bénira, \q et toutes les extrémités de la terre {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craindront.
fr.B: Dieu va nous bénir, \q et tous les confins de la terre {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} révéreront.
fr.R: Dieu nous bénira. \q Alors les gens de partout, même des endroits les plus lointains, {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honoreront avec respect.

sw.L: Mungu atatubariki, \q na miisho yote ya dunia itamcha {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.B: Mungu atatubariki, \q na pembe zote za mbali za dunia zitamcha {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.R: Mungu atatubariki. \q Ndipo watu kila mahali, hata mahali pa mbali kabisa, watamheshimu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kwa hofu takatifu.

es.L: Dios nos bendecirá, \q y {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} temerán todos los confines de la tierra.
es.B: Dios nos va a bendecir, \q y todos los rincones lejanos de la tierra {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} reverenciarán.
es.R: Dios nos bendecirá. \q Entonces la gente de todas partes, aun de los lugares más lejanos, {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honrará con reverencia.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban phước cho chúng ta, \q và mọi nơi tận cùng trái đất sẽ kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban phước cho chúng ta, \q và mọi nơi xa xôi nhất trên đất sẽ kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời sẽ ban phước cho chúng ta. \q Khi ấy người ta ở khắp nơi, ngay cả những nơi xa nhất, sẽ tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 하나님께서 우리에게 복을 주실 것이요, \q 땅의 모든 끝이 그분을 경외할 것이다.
ko.B: 하나님께서 우리에게 복을 주시리니, \q 땅의 먼 끝까지 모두 그분을 경외할 것이다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 우리에게 복을 주실 것이다. \q 그러면 가장 먼 곳에 사는 사람들까지 모두 그분을 두려운 마음으로 섬길 것이다.

pt.L: Deus nos abençoará, \q e todos os confins da terra {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} temerão.
pt.B: Deus vai nos abençoar, \q e todos os cantos mais distantes da terra vão reverenciá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.
pt.R: Deus vai nos abençoar. \q Então as pessoas de todo lugar, até dos lugares mais distantes, vão honrá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} com reverência.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ይባርከናል፤ \q የምድር ዳርቻዎችም ሁሉ ይፈሩታል።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ይባርከናል፤ \q የምድር ዳርቻዎች ሁሉ በፍርሃት ያከብሩታል።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ይባርከናል። \q ያን ጊዜ በየቦታው፣ በሩቅ ስፍራዎችም ጭምር ያሉ ሰዎች በፍርሃት ያከብሩታል።

hi.L: परमेश्वर हमें आशीष देंगे, \q और पृथ्वी के सब छोर उनका भय मानेंगे।
hi.B: परमेश्वर हमें आशीष देनेवाले हैं, \q और पृथ्वी के दूर-दूर के कोने उनका आदर और भय मानेंगे।
hi.R: परमेश्वर हमें आशीष देंगे। \q तब हर जगह के लोग, सबसे दूर के स्थानों में भी, आदर और भय के साथ उनका सम्मान करेंगे।

ru.L: Благословит нас Бог, \q и убоятся {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}} все концы земли.
ru.B: Бог благословит нас, \q и все дальние края земли будут благоговеть перед {{deity_pronoun:ним|Ним}}.
ru.R: Бог благословит нас. \q Тогда люди повсюду, даже в самых дальних краях, будут с благоговением почитать {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.

ja.L: 神は、わたしたちを祝福される。 \q 地の果てのすべての者は、その方を恐れる。
ja.B: 神は、わたしたちを祝福してくださる。 \q 地の果てに至るまで、すべての者がその方を畏れる。
ja.R: 神は、わたしたちを祝福してくださる。 \q そして、地上のどこにいる人々も、いちばん遠い所の人々も、神をおそれ敬う。

decisions.choice: and they will fear him: the result of the blessing
alternatives: let all the ends of the earth fear him
decisions.reason: The "and" introduces the result: the nations see God's goodness to Israel and come to revere him. It may also be a wish.

decisions.choice: the ends of the earth: the farthest peoples
decisions.reason: As in 2:8 and 22:28, the phrase means all peoples, to the edges of the known world.

decisions.choice: people everywhere, even in the farthest places
decisions.reason: Readable says who is meant (m2).

decisions.choice: kol-'afse-'arets "地の果てのすべての者" (L), "地の果てに至るまで、すべての者" (B), "地上のどこにいる人々も、いちばん遠い所の人々も" (R); yir'u "恐れる" / "畏れる" / "おそれ敬う"
decisions.reason: The farthest peoples (m2); fear of God as the Psalter conventions.
